name: Runner Extras - Integer virtual table
brief: Proves the Integer system virtual table (2000000026) yields rows, so `dataitem(X; Integer)` report datasets are not silently empty.
description: The Integer metatable is parsed out of the platform package, so it exists — but nothing provides rows, so every Record Integer is empty. Real BC exposes one row per value of Number across the full signed-integer range, and `dataitem(Name; Integer)` with a DataItemTableView filter is THE standard idiom for a synthetic report dataset (28 of Pageworks' 29 test reports use it). With zero rows the report body never executes: SaveAs completes successfully, writes nothing, raises no error, and any `asserterror` around it fails with 'An error was expected inside an ASSERTERROR statement' — a silent wrong answer rather than a loud one. This suite pins the AL surface that matters: a const filter yielding exactly one row, a range filter yielding a counted set in order, iteration reading Number, and negative cases (an empty range finds nothing; a provider that answers true to everything fails here).
